_comment: LTX-Video text-to-video. Node set taken from ComfyUI's own ltxv_text_to_video example, so it uses the built-in LTXV nodes rather than a custom pack — one less thing to drift. LTX ships model+VAE in one checkpoint and takes T5 separately, hence CheckpointLoaderSimple plus CLIPLoader(type=ltxv). LTX is distilled and runs at CFG ~1: a negative prompt has almost nothing to push against, so __NEGATIVE__ is present but deliberately expected to be near-empty. Output is native SaveWEBM rather than VHS_VideoCombine: it needs no custom node, and the app's ffmpeg step converts to mp4 anyway.
